pluss::make_timeline¶

Back to Timeline Factory API Reference

Signature¶

Timeline pluss::make_timeline(text_input values)

Flat Shortcut For pluss::timeline::make¶

pluss::make_timeline() is a permanent public alias of pluss::timeline::make(). Every overload forwards directly to the namespaced factory, so parsing, shape inference, timezone handling, nanosecond precision, ownership, and failures are identical.

Use whichever spelling makes the construction site clearer. This page is intentionally brief; the complete accepted grammar, overload inventory, edge behavior, and failure modes are taught on timeline::make.

Example 1: Scalar Shortcut¶

const auto value = pluss::make_timeline(
    "2024-02-29T23:30:45.123456789-07:00");
std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::timeline::format(value, "%FT%T.%f%z")) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
"2024-03-01T06:30:45.123456789+00:00"

Example 2: Flat Runtime Data And Shape¶

const std::vector<std::string> flat{
    "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-03", "2024-01-04"};
const auto matrix = pluss::make_timeline(flat, {2, 2});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::timeline::format(matrix, "%F")) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[2, 2], dim=2, numel=4, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-02"], 
  ["2024-01-03", "2024-01-04"]
]
